decisions.reason: The cleaning soap is a low-cost complement to the core flooring offer and shows no shortfall against aspiration, and with industry growth and hiring the firm has the slack to keep it.
The maintenance oil line supports the firm's surface-treatment positioning, needs few resources and likely meets aspirations, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
Care products for oiled floors are standard companions to parquet sales and strengthen customer relationships, though some overlap with the oil line slightly raises the risk of consolidation.
The moisture-protection underlay is a system accessory that installers expect and shows no sign of underperforming against aspirations.
The high-density underlay foam fits the flooring-system offer, and although it may overlap with other underlays, slack makes keeping it the satisficing choice.
